title: Connector metadata
description: Machine-readable metadata the takaro.io website uses to build a downloads page from a connector's GitHub releases.

tagline.description: One short sentence describing the connector.

assetMode.description: 'pick-one' when the user picks ONE of the assets; 'all' when every listed asset is needed together.

assets.description: Release assets the website should render as download entries.

pattern.description: Glob matching the release asset filename.

label.description: Short label shown on the download button.

requires.description: Version/runtime constraints for this asset, using ' · ' as separator.

hint.description: Short install hint for this asset.

required.description: False for genuinely optional assets (e.g. a client-side companion).
